prompt: A worker escalation correctly withholds any replan claim when it has no valid replan evidence, and the ledger schema validator flags a malformed replan claim as invalid rather than trusting it.

assertions: contains:'replan_evidence' must be a string or null, got int

eval.contract: A default Escalation (is_replannable=False, replan_evidence=None) validates clean, while an Escalation that sets is_replannable=True but supplies non-string replan_evidence is rejected by ledger.validate_escalation with an explicit type-mismatch issue, so an unsubstantiated replan claim is never silently accepted.
